slides.title: Northern Ethiopia faces emergency hunger risk
slides.body: FEWS NET warns drought and fighting are colliding.

slides.title: Emergency (IPC Phase 4) possible from February 2027
slides.body: In the worst drought-hit parts of Tigray, Amhara and Afar, FEWS NET projects.

slides.title: Fighting has disrupted farming and trade
slides.body: FEWS NET says conflict intensified in late September in eastern, central and northwestern Tigray and in eastern and northern Amhara.

slides.title: drop in people reached with food aid from August to September
slides.body: Just over 700,000 got food aid in September. Coverage may be higher, as some data was missing.

slides.title: crop losses in the East and West Hararghe lowlands
slides.body: Some of the most vulnerable households there could also face Emergency outcomes, FEWS NET says.

slides.title: Protect civilians. Let food aid reach every area.
slides.body: Follow for sourced updates from across Ethiopia.

source: Source: FEWS NET via Addis Standard, Nov 12, 2026
